comparison.objective: Classify and discard oily rags into the oily-waste safety can rather than ordinary trash; candidate finishes HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Material/category recognition and waste-container placement versus precise alignment, bimanual impact regulation, and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Oily rags enter the safety can and not the trash versus four tangs fracture and reach a containment tray without loss or damage.
comparison.reason: Hazardous-waste sorting is clearly different from impact finishing. Container operation, counts, scoring thresholds, and spec versions are missing.
